accuracy.reason: All card objectives use bounded gateway claims: TLS trust, per-resource permission, counter scope, unknown write outcomes and effect-owned atomic deduplication. Diagrams preserve request/response and trust boundaries.

evidence.quote: Encrypting a connection alone does not prove that its caller is the gateway.

mechanisms.reason: Request actors, identity replacement, 100+100 admission, deadline budget, 3x3 retries and transactional duplicate records make both normal operation and failure traceable.

evidence.quote: In one transaction, reserve that key uniquely, apply the effect and record its result; commit all or none.

coherence.reason: Flow and shared policies establish the entrance boundary; identity, limits, waiting, retry safety and aggregation build into the availability/adoption decision.

evidence.quote: Retry attempts and their delays spend the same remaining budget; each attempt does not get a fresh two seconds.

decisions.reason: Explains shared-policy benefits and extra hop/operations costs, exact-quota availability tradeoffs, required/optional response choices and when a single API needs no gateway.

evidence.quote: A single API can enforce its own identity checks, permissions and request limits.

clarity.reason: Definitions are local and concrete examples expose scope and failure effects without unexplained jargon. The learner labels its own deadline allocation as a choice rather than quoted policy.

evidence.quote: Two local counters are not one shared allowance

outcomes.reason: Cards 1/2 teach client-gateway-service-return flow, service routing versus replica selection, decrypted HTTP and bounded pre-forward body checks, and service-owned business validation. Learner covers all.

Card 3 supports validated identity versus per-note permission, removal of forged Bob claim, authenticated/verifiable identity path, bypass prevention and Alice denial absent permission. Learner states each.
Card 4 supports combined scope, 200 independent admissions, bursts/best effort versus strict quota, coordinated cost, delayed bounded 429 retries and unequal downstream work. Learner covers each.

Cards 5/6 support shared deadline, timeout ambiguity, nine nested attempts with one bounded owner, stable caller/operation key across replicas and durable atomic result/effect recording. Learner rejects gateway-only and fresh-key approaches.
Card 7 supports fan-out cost despite fewer client calls, bounded optional waits, marked partial names and failure for missing required notes. Learner gives a coherent explicitly chosen allocation.
Card 8 supports omitting a gateway for one adequate API, shared-policy justification, extra hop/operations, reachable surviving capacity and limits on database, shared-policy and permission failures.

sourceChecks.claim: Microsoft gateway guidance supports client-facing reverse proxy, shared policies, routing and load balancing roles; diagram correctly returns response through gateway.
Microsoft offloading supports shared TLS/policy handling and backend separation; inspection requires decrypted HTTP, and bounded pre-forward rejection avoids unbounded buffering.
OWASP requires protected/verifiable propagated identity, separate caller authentication, service-level resource rules and prevention of gateway bypass.
Microsoft rate-limit-by-key documents per-key 429 behavior and distributed imprecision/scope. Independent 100 counters allow 200; strict shared admission needs coordinated accounting.
AWS timeout/retry guidance confirms lost response can follow side effects, retries consume time/load and bounded backoff is needed; timeout alone does not undo work.
AWS idempotent API article confirms caller plus request identity, ACID token/effect coordination and equivalent repeated results; 3x3 attempt amplification is correct.
Microsoft aggregation guidance explicitly distinguishes acceptable partial responses from required complete data and calls for timeout/failure policy.
Microsoft routing guidance identifies gateway failure/bottleneck and operational load testing; replicas do not create backend capacity or repair shared rules.
